# Set Max Health

Source: [4422](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4422); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Set Max Health](../../api/actions/set-max-health.md).

<a id="wiki-4422-n1"></a>

- Set Max Health uses a percentage of raw max health and clamps current health so it cannot exceed the new maximum.
